**Indikator 8** is a quality indicator managed by the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] that measures the proportion of treatment courses among adult patients (the [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]]) who have initiated ADHD-related psychoeducation no later than 120 days after the start of treatment [^src1] [^src2]. This indicator is reported for the first time without historical data, covering the initial calculation period from April 1, 2024, to March 31, 2025 [^src1]. 

Nationally, the performance on Indikator 8 revealed significant systemic challenges in the Danish psychiatric healthcare system. Only 36% (95% CI: 34–38) of adult ADHD patients began psychoeducation within the required timeframe, falling substantially short of the 90% development target [^src2]. Regional results varied considerably, ranging from a low of 18% in [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] to 50% in [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], with [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] just below at 49% [^src2]. At the departmental level, three units achieved high scores of 80% or above: [[psy-lokalpsykiatri-toender|PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder)]] (83%), [[pho-klinik-1-for-psykiatriske-lidelser-horsens|PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens]] (82%), and [[pmi-klinik-for-depression-og-mani-midt|PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt]] (80%) [^src2]. Conversely, [[privathospitaler|Privathospitaler]] reported a zero score, with no patients registered as having started ADHD psychoeducation [^src2].

Strategically, Indikator 8 plays a central role in the ongoing evaluation of ADHD treatment quality. The steering group has discussed prioritizing efforts to bring Indikator 8 closer to its fulfillment target before fully implementing the newly introduced Indikator 9, which focuses on psychotherapy [^src3]. This highlights the indicator's importance in shaping future clinical standards, resource allocation, and structural capacity within the national ADHD treatment framework.

## Claims

**Performance**
- Indikator 8 opnåede 36 % (95 % CI: 34–38) i perioden 01.04.2024–31.03.2025 og rapporteres første gang uden historik [^src1]
- På landsplan påbegyndte 36 % af de voksne ADHD-patienter psykoedukation inden for tidsfristen, hvilket er betydeligt under udviklingsmålet på 90.[^src1] [^src2]

## Timeline

- 01.04.2024: Start af opgørelsesperioden for Indikator 8 (01.04.2024–31.03.2025) [^src1]
